protocol.loss: Unweighted BCEWithLogits mean over all pooled target cells; no Dice/GT smoothing
protocol.architecture: Smap1 or SOCmaps3 -> Conv1x1 to64/GN8/GELU -> two Conv3x3 64/GN8/GELU -> Conv1x1 to1 logits
protocol.fusion_features: Only original raw FP32 scalar outputs: S/O sigmoid and C softplus, ordered S/O/C; no intermediate64-channel feature or raw RGB-D bypass
protocol.frozen: All DINO/SigLIP/MultiMAE and S20/O12/C19 parameters/buffers fixed eval/no_grad
protocol.sharing: One scene DINO 2/5/8/11 forward; fixed center reference with original stream-specific preprocessing
protocol.head_initialization: Fresh seed0; same body/output/project GN tensors as original feature heads. Only first convolution input channels differ.
protocol.gt: Existing amodal binary native640x480 /255, exact avg16 to30x40; no regenerated dataset
protocol.deployment: Same one RGB-D, target reference; sigmoid30x40 then float bilinear640x480, no GT mask
protocol.split: Unchanged CommonIndex target/scene split; no feature cache or reassignment
protocol.test_rule: Select each model by validation BCE; save both complete test predictions before original native evaluator reads test GT.
protocol.evaluation: native IoU@0.5, native highest-score point hit; visible/fully-hidden, camera, target groups
protocol.hypothesis: Do actual scalar stream predictions provide complementary target localization and removal utility, compared with feature fusion and S-map-only control?
protocol.map_transform: No quantization, clipping, workspace/GT masking, per-image normalization, C/6 division, RGB conversion or custom calibration. Input projection/GN learned normally.

cache.rationale: Frozen deterministic map extraction once in canonical split order; identical training minibatch16 and permutation.
cache.train_val_supervision: Reuse verified read-only original avg16 amodal caches from completed S-feature control.
cache.test_supervision: Never cached/decoded until all new head test predictions are saved.

protocol.training_transport: FP32 maps and train/val GT may reside on GPU; original batch16/order/optimizer remain unchanged. Training DataLoader workers replaced only for transport; extraction workers4.
protocol.two_stage_training: Frozen streams trained on same train pool. Fusion uses in-sample train predictions; not out-of-fold stacking. Val/test splits remain isolated from gradient updates.
protocol.scope: S-map/SOC-map fitting and test plus later fixed32-layout5-view removal comparison against feature S/SOC; no new scene/GT or transformer/gating/GT-mixture.

definitions.visibility: original raw physical IDs; visible if >0 pixels, fully_occluded if visible=0 and amodal>0, otherwise out_of_frame
